notes.title: Status Update
notes.notes:
Hey there! It's been a while since we've posted something. Sadly we had some things happen and due personal circumstances we couldnt continue working on Tribes & Monsters for a while. But we did not just standby the whole time and we're coming back with some now structures and a new project? So here are a few new things for this month and what we're planning for the future of Foxel Games and Tribes & Monsters.

- We've started working on a new project - Beat the Odds!
- Foxy is trying out streaming again and want to do this regularly, maybe you can catch him working for once over at https://twitch.tv/FoxelGames
- Tribes & Monsters will receive a new updates with the promised dwarves, a new biome and more bosses for the existing biomes.
- We're planning to keep you updated with a monthly report like this one, explaning what to expect for the next month.

Thank you for sticking around with us!
Kind regards,
Foxel, Sen and Lia

notes.title: Patch Notes - V1.0.0c
notes.notes:
We're finally getting the S into TribeS & Monsters.

[b]Early Access V1.0.0c
Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] We've added the [b]Undead Tribe[/b] with a new village, they're still collecting the buddies and there'll be some more units and hero joining them soon.
[*] -- To unlock the Undead you'll need a Undead Key, currently purchasable via the Event Shop, head back to the Tribe selection and either drag over to the Undead or use the A and D Keys to circle through the selection.
[*] The Debuff System got reworked and a new Debuff [b]Poison [/b]was added.
[*] We added the missing Halloween Skin for the Queen, make sure to unlock it before the release of our upcoming Event Blastin' Holidays!
[*] Changed the displayed Rewards for the Grassland Biome.
[*] 
[*] We've added the Linux Version of the Game to Steam, this is highly experimental and we hope its working it.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Vampire Skin for the King, it no longer glitches around.
[/list]
[b]
If you like our game please make sure to leave a review on Steam, it'll help us out a lot![/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA V 1.0.0b
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a small delay after defeating the final boss in a round
[*] Nimble Swordskill upgrade now instead grants additional attacks on the same enemy if there's no other valid target to hit.
[*] Burn got reworked, the button was moved and you can now select one of the remaining upgrades after burning a upgrade.
[*] Added a Halloween exclusive Skin for the King hero.
[*] Added a little sneak peak at the upcoming village for the Undead tribe.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Shop Cards now always update their status as soon as something is added or removed from the inventory.
[*] Death knight in the Graveyard no longer drop soulstones instead of candies.
[*] Your selected hero now gets saved and it'll no longer get reset back to the Princess hero.
[*] The background music in the human village will now loop correctly.
[*] You'll no longer start your run with already lost health.
[*] Fixed the Iceoid Hitbox not correctly working if they spawn as an elite.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA V1.0.0a
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new enemy to the Tundra biome: Iceonid
[*] Enemies now despawn as soon as the boss spawns, this will prevent performance issues during the boss fight.
[*] Level Selection now shows you the most common rewards for the selected biome.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] We reworked the application of armor and added some additional informations to the upgrade card.
[*] Fixed the possibilty to go into negative amounts of currency when purchasing skins.
[*] Owl's in the tundra biome no longer drop Earth soulstones instead of Wind soulstones.
[*] Mummies in the Desert biome no longer drop Earth soulstones instead of Fire soulstones.
[/list]
